### Pseudobulk


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
so_iso_M <- subset(so_M %>% set_idents("treatment"), idents = "Isotype")

    so_iso_M,
    metadata = so_iso_M@meta.data %>%
        mutate(mouse_no_underscore = str_replace_all(mouse, "_", ".")) %>%
        select(mouse_no_underscore)
)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
so_iso_M <- AddMetaData(
    so_iso_M,
    metadata = so_iso_M@meta.data %>%
      mutate(general_M_subtypes_grouped = case_when(
        general_M_subtypes %in% c("MDSC", "Proliferating", "Macrophages", "Monocytes") ~ "Mac/mono", 
        TRUE ~ general_M_subtypes
      )) %>% 
      dplyr::select(general_M_subtypes_grouped)
)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
out <- run_or_readRDS(
  file.path(results_dir, "pb_iso_Mgrouped.rds"),
  function() {
    pb_list <-
      make_pseudobulk(so_iso_M, "general_M_subtypes_grouped", "mouse_no_underscore", "genotype")
    deseq_list <-
      map(pb_list,
          ~ pb_to_deseq(..1, sample_var = "general_M_subtypes_grouped", vars = "genotype"))
    rlog_list <-
      map(deseq_list, rlog, blind = TRUE)
    return(list(pb_list, deseq_list, rlog_list))
  }
)

pb_list <- out[[1]]
deseq_list <- out[[2]]
rlog_list <- out[[3]]
```
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
norm_counts <- counts(deseq_list$`Mac/mono`, normalized = TRUE) %>%
```

#### Heatmap visualization


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
dge_b2m.v.WT <- pb_dge_df

topn <- 100
top_n_genes <- dge_b2m.v.WT %>% 
  filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>% 
  arrange(padj) %>% 
  head(topn) %>% 
  .$gene
bot_n_genes <- dge_b2m.v.WT %>% 
  filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>% 
  arrange(padj) %>% 
  head(topn) %>% 
  .$gene
```
:::


Looking at the top 100 genes, either way


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
h_mtx <- norm_counts %>% 
  filter(gene %in% top_n_genes | gene %in% bot_n_genes) %>% 
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = c(top_n_genes, rev(bot_n_genes)))) %>% 
  arrange(gene) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("gene") %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  t() %>% 
  scale() %>% 
  t()
Heatmap(h_mtx, 
        cluster_rows = FALSE, 
        name = "scaled expr.",
        show_row_names = FALSE)
```

### Single cell


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
m_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "subsetMremoveddoublets")
dge_b2m.v.WT <- readRDS(
    file.path(
        m_dir,
        "dge_filterRNA200mito10_subsetM_markers_isotype_macs_b2m.v.wt.rds"
    )
) %>% 
    as_tibble(rownames = "gene")
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
datatable(dge_b2m.v.WT %>%
            filter(avg_log2FC > 0) %>%
            arrange(p_val_adj) %>%
            filter(str_detect(gene, "Rpl|Rps", negate = TRUE)))
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
datatable(dge_b2m.v.WT %>%
            filter(avg_log2FC < 0) %>%
            arrange(p_val_adj) %>%
            filter(str_detect(gene, "Rpl|Rps", negate = TRUE)))
```
:::




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
top_b2m <- dge_b2m.v.WT %>% 
    filter(avg_log2FC > 0) %>% 
    arrange(p_val, desc(avg_log2FC)) %>% 
    filter(str_detect(gene, "Rpl|Rps", negate = TRUE)) %>% 
    head(6) 
top_wt <- dge_b2m.v.WT %>% 
    filter(avg_log2FC < 0) %>% 
    arrange(p_val, desc(avg_log2FC)) %>% 
    filter(str_detect(gene, "Rpl|Rps", negate = TRUE)) %>% 
    head(6)
gene_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so_M, genes = c(top_b2m$gene, top_wt$gene)) %>% 
    filter(!(clusters_M %in% c("8: Monocytic DCs", "9: cDC1", "10: Migratory DCs", "11: pDC", "12: Neutrophils"))) %>% 
    filter(treatment == "Isotype")
gene_df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(top_b2m$gene, top_wt$gene)) %>%
    mutate(cat = ifelse(name %in% top_b2m$gene, "higher in B2m KO", "higher in WT")) %>%
    mutate(cat = factor(cat, levels = c("higher in WT", "higher in B2m KO"))) %>% 
    mutate(genotype = ifelse(genotype == "Ctrl", "WT", genotype)) %>% 
    ggplot() +
    aes(name, value) +
    see::geom_violinhalf(aes(fill = genotype), 
                         scale = "width",
                         color = NA, 
                         data = ~..1 %>% filter(genotype == "B2m KO")) + 
    see::geom_violinhalf(aes(fill = genotype), 
                         scale = "width",
                         color = NA, 
                         data = ~..1 %>% filter(genotype == "WT"), 
                         flip = TRUE) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_genotype_renamed) + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + 
    facet_wrap( ~ cat, scale = "free_x") + 
    remove_x_spine() + 
    theme(legend.position = c(0.3, 0.95),
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1.2)) + 
    labs(x = "gene", y = "log-normalized expr.")
```

## ssGSEA


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
sig_dir <- here("data", "signatures")
mouse_human_genes <- readRDS(here("data", "mouse_human_genes.rds")) %>% 
    as_tibble()
jablonski_df <-
    read_tsv(
        file.path(
            sig_dir,
            "m2_sigs",
            "Combined_Jablonski_Alt_Class_Mac.gmt.txt"
        ),
        col_names = FALSE
    ) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(signature = X1, source = X2) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-X759) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = 3:ncol(.), 
                 names_to = "column", 
                 values_to = "gene") %>% 
    filter(!is.na(gene)) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-column) %>% 
    left_join(mouse_human_genes, by = c("gene" = "HGNC.symbol")) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(human_gene = gene) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(gene = MGI.symbol) 
jablonski_gs <- jablonski_df %>% 
    drop_na(gene) %>% 
    named_group_split(signature) %>% 
    map(~..1$gene)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ranked_b2m_KO <- results(deseq_list$`Mac/mono`) %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% 
    mutate(signed_pval = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, -log10(pvalue + 1e-100), log10(pvalue + 1e-100))) %>% 
    arrange(desc(signed_pval), desc(log2FoldChange)) %>% 
    {set_names(.$signed_pval, .$gene)}
altact_jab_df <- Rsc::get_leading_edge_df(ranked_b2m_KO, gs_vec = jablonski_gs$`AltActivated(IL4)_Jablonski`)
leg_df <- jablonski_gs %>% 
    map_dfr(~Rsc::get_leading_edge_df(ranked_b2m_KO, gs_vec = ..1), 
            .id = "gs_name") 
```
